title: HelmetBanner
description: Allow player to wear banner as helmet
body:
HelmetBanner

A lightweight, high-performance utility that allows players to wear any Banner as a helmet. Perfect for factions, team events, or just showing off your custom designs!

Features

-Simple Mechanics: Just pick up a banner and click your helmet slot to equip it.

-Ultra Lightweight: Zero armor stands, zero entities, and zero lag.

-Native Feel: No complex commands needed—it feels like a part of the vanilla game.

Created by pc-g & Gemini
